description.en:
Sets the second objective text of the match, the "d_" version of the objective text, together with a character. CMND_BTL_SET_PURPOSETEXT already fills the text ID field with "d_" plus its own text ID; this function sets it explicitly and also records the character.
The scripts call it right after SET_PURPOSETEXT with the matching IDs, e.g. ("d_purpose_021", "para_cp0009") after (true, "purpose_021", "para_cp0009"), and with (0, 0) to clear it.
Where this second text is displayed was not traced.
Message ID of the second text, e.g. "d_purpose_021", or 0 to clear.
Parameter ID of the character linked to the text, or 0. Left unchanged when omitted.

true once the fields are set.
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.
